review.note: Direct paired review of the m123 run frames (reviewer viewed both images): candidate renders the SCP-JP localized Flopstyle: DARK page, reference renders the EN theme page, so page content and language differ by construction. Theme identity matches across the pair: dark slate background, hot-pink masthead, title and links, green sidebox headers, fold/navigation sidebar, centered emblem, rating and credit module placement. The candidate top bar holds all five JP items on a single line with no wrap or overflow. One minor heading-treatment difference: the reference page title renders its second word outlined while the candidate title is solid pink, which follows the two source pages' own title markup and does not affect theme identity. No actionable divergence.

Direct paired review of the m123 run frames (reviewer viewed both images): at laptop width both frames collapse the side columns. Candidate JP masthead and five-item top bar are contained on a single line; emblem, title and rating module placement agree with the reference. Same minor title-treatment difference as desktop. No actionable divergence.

Direct paired review of the m123 run frames (reviewer viewed both images): candidate top bar holds all five JP items on one line inside the frame; both frames show the fixed menu button overlapping the start of the login line in the same way. Emblem, title and rating placement agree. No actionable divergence.

Direct paired review of the m123 run frames (reviewer viewed both images): candidate mobile top bar shows the four SCP-JP items on one line, fully inside the 390px frame with no overflow - the bar whose endpoint submenus are the #3390 subject; the reference shows its three EN items. Masthead, emblem and rating modules agree. No actionable divergence.

Direct paired review of the m123 run frames (reviewer viewed both images): at 320px the candidate top bar wraps to two lines (three items, then the last item at the left of the second row) - the wrap case the successor placement rule is designed to be independent of - with everything inside the frame and no overflow; the reference keeps its three items on one line. Masthead, emblem and rating modules agree. No actionable divergence.
